articles.title: VanEck Renames Green Metals ETF to Reflect Copper’s Role in Global Electrification and AI-Driven Infrastructure

articles.summary: Business Wire: VanEck Renames Green Metals ETF to Reflect Copper’s Role in Global Electrification and AI-Driven Infrastructure.
